description: Dept. of Trade and Investment Policy - Customs Duty on Black Grams, Beans etc., under Revenue Order No. 03/2019
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns a notification under the Customs Ordinance, specifically detailing changes to import duty rates on various goods. It involves the implementation of a parliamentary resolution to modify customs duties, which falls under the category of regulatory and legal framework matters. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory changes rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
